notes.title: Introducing Super Woden GP 2
notes.content:
It makes me very happy to inform you that Super Woden GP 2 is very close to being released.

New physics, a huge number of vehicles and circuits, new game modes, the ability to customize vehicle names and much more!

Please add it to your wish list:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2083210/Super_Woden_GP_2/

notes.title: No more stuttering Update!
notes.content:
There have been countless attempts to satisfy that part of the players who were affected by certain stuttering, especially on monitors with high refresh rates. Finally and after some tests I can proudly announce that it has finally been solved. Finally, in my day at work I came up with an idea, and it works like a charm.

This update consists of:
*The game runs much smoother than before. Not only certain stuttering issues on some computers, but it's something that other players will notice as well. Any refresh rate can be used.

*Added an extra difficulty level for those of you looking for a bigger challenge.

*2 new achievements will be added soon, based on difficulty and mileage.

Please, if you detect any bug or problem, do not hesitate to let me know.
That's it. Thank you very much for playing!

notes.title: Super Woden GP looks like a promising upcoming top-down racer
notes.content:
Featuring a top-down view, Super Woden GP looks like it could bring some excitement when it comes to Linux later this year. After the awesome experience that art of rally was, I'm keen to see more.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/05/super-woden-gp-looks-like-a-promising-upcoming-top-down-racer
